metadata.title: Ghana Tertiary Admissions — Final Round Checked Baseline
metadata.verificationPrinciple: Official institutional sources first. Third-party figures are not treated as authoritative cutoffs.
metadata.criticalRule: A general eligibility threshold is never represented as a programme-specific cutoff.
metadata.cutoffMeaning: cutoffAggregate is populated only where an official programme-specific cutoff/guide or a national benchmark is explicitly identified.
metadata.nullMeaning: No reliable programme-specific cutoff was verified in the official material reviewed for this round.
metadata.historicalMeaning: Historical official guides are retained only when the institution itself identifies them as historical/previous-year guidance.
metadata.sourceCaveat: Not every requested institution publishes a current programme-by-programme cutoff table. Where that table is absent, the dataset preserves null rather than inventing estimates.
